title: Backups
desc: Snapshot a project (optionally with audio) and restore later.
lede: Backups let you snapshot a project and roll back if something goes wrong.
body:
At a glance
  • Create a backup with a comment.
  • Optionally include audio samples.
  • Download, restore, or delete snapshots.

Create a backup

Snapshot the project, with an optional comment to remember why. Toggle whether to include audio samples (bigger, but complete).

Restore & manage

Download, restore, or delete snapshots. Restoring rolls the project back to that point. See Backups & Recovery for the bigger picture.
